question: In Tailwind v4, how do you add a brand color that generates `bg-brand-500` and `text-brand-500`?
options: Declare `--color-brand-500` inside an `@theme` block in your CSS
explanation: v4 is configured in CSS. Variables in the `--color-*` namespace inside `@theme` generate every color utility and are also exposed as CSS variables.

question: Why does `className={`text-${tone}-700`}` usually render without color?
options: Tailwind does not support template strings in React
The scanner reads source as text and never sees the full class name, so no CSS is generated
The class needs the `!` important modifier
explanation: Tailwind never executes your code. Map values to complete class strings so they appear literally in the source.

question: What does `p-4 md:p-6` mean?
options: Padding 1rem below `md` and 1.5rem from the `md` breakpoint up
The classes conflict and the first one wins
explanation: Breakpoint variants are min-width (mobile first): the unprefixed utility applies everywhere until a larger breakpoint overrides it.
